$description: Shipped button values, copied from the two style-guide artifacts (read 2026-10-26); iOS primary and text link re-recorded from the TroncKit f79fe3339 export and the Apps team answers (DREAMT-4718, 2026-11-19); Android text link color re-recorded from the Android screenshots (2026-11-19). Source data: do not edit except to record a new app export. Values not in the source are null with a note; provisional values used by the pilot are in data/button-decisions.json.

sources.ios: MNG iOS Style Guide artifact (https://claude.ai/artifact/V364juyHFU3STfVZ6EgjMc), TroncKit @ f79fe3339: project/5-controls.md, project/tokens.json (radius-purchase, size-button-purchase, paywall-purchase, paywall-login-link); Apps team answers DREAMT-4718 (2026-11-18, 2026-11-19: MISSING-ASSETS 5.4 correction and 5.10); colors from data/source/markets.json
sources.android: MNG Android Style Guide artifact (https://claude.ai/artifact/5MyLP13QSt52WGRgXW35ZJ), android-tribpub @ 1cfb069a6: project/5-controls.md, project/components/Buttons, project/tokens.json; colors from data/source/android-markets.json

ios.where: Meter paywall purchase button (the primary button every market shows; Paywall.storyboard)
ios.label_text: TRY ONE MONTH FREE ("Paywall_SubscriptionOffers_CallToAction".localized.uppercased(), the same in all 78 markets)
ios.legacy_note: No legacy-template difference: all 78 markets use the same storyboard button (Apps team, 5.10).
ios.height_source: size-button-purchase: constraint is at least 45 pt; one line of fixed 14 pt text, so always 45 in practice (Apps team, 5.10)
ios.disabled_note: No disabled style ships on the purchase button.
ios.pressed_note: No custom pressed state: the title fades and the fill stays the same (Apps team, 5.4).

previous.why_replaced: Paywall Log In / Register are native Arc login buttons that production never shows (Auth0 web view in every market, Apps team 2026-11-18).

android.label_color: #ffffff (Paywall_Button_TextColor; 6 markets use a selector with disabled @color/text_disabled)

font.note: Weight and size not in the source.

android.radius_source: radius-paywall: plain color background, no corner radius

disabled.source: Your News Continue background (bg_continue) and Text_Disabled_Font / button_color selector
